# Brand Banao Digital

> Brand Banao Digital is a Delhi NCR digital studio for web development, digital marketing, and media production. The team builds fast websites, creates Instagram Reels, manages paid campaigns, and improves local SEO for businesses, creators, and political campaigns.

## General Information

- **Company Name:** Brand Banao Digital
- **Website:** https://brandbanaodigital.in/
- **Phone:** +91-8800886698
- **Location:** Delhi, Delhi NCR, India (Geo-coordinates: 28.6139, 77.2090)
- **Pricing Range:** ₹5,999 – ₹42,999
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/brandbanaodigital.in

---

## Core Services & Solutions

### 1. Web Development
Custom website design and development for business branding, e-commerce, and governance use cases. Work can include responsive UI/UX, Generative AI chatbot integrations, and structured data setup. We make and manage websites

### 2. Reels & Video Production
Complete short-form video production for Instagram and YouTube reach for personal branding and political campaigning. Services cover scripting, shooting, editing, and digital storytelling for brands and political campaigns.

### 3. Local SEO & Digital Marketing
Local search optimization focused on Google visibility, map discovery, regional keyword targeting, paid advertising, and digital presence management across Delhi NCR and areas such as Rajasthan.

### 4. Political & Election Campaign Strategy
Digital campaign planning for constituencies, including outreach, local issue messaging, social media management, and voter-focused web platforms.

---

## Featured Work & Client Portfolio

- **The Indian Spice Co.** ([https://theindianspiceco.in/](https://theindianspiceco.in/)): Scalable website experience with a clean interface and Generative AI chatbot support.
- **Swaroop Singh Khara (Political Leader)** ([https://swaroopsinghkhara.com/](https://swaroopsinghkhara.com/)): Constituency-focused portal with local issue pages, event coverage, and voter discovery improvements.
- **Manpasand Enterprises** ([https://manpasandenterprises.co.in/](https://manpasandenterprises.co.in/)): Business website with product catalogue, enquiry capture, and Google Business integration.
- **Jai Bajrang Bhojanalay** ([https://jaibajrangbhojanalay.in/](https://jaibajrangbhojanalay.in/)): Restaurant web presence with menu details, opening hours, directions, and instant call options.
- **Kishan Singh Kaludi (Sarpanch Kaludi)** ([https://kishansinghkaludi.in/](https://kishansinghkaludi.in/)): Hindi governance portal for local schemes, development updates, and direct community contact.
